content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect calculations for the maximum sizes of the input buffer before and after the first wrap, which were not properly aligned to the frame size of the ATRAC audio data. This led to potential buffer overflows or misalignment issues when reading audio data, especially when the buffer was not full. The patch corrects these calculations to ensure that the buffer sizes are aligned correctly based on the ATRAC frame size, preventing issues during audio decoding and playback.
